title: Extract duplicated CI bootstrap steps into a shared composite action

evidence.quote:
# Shared Flutter + pub setup extracted via composite action pattern (inline reuse via YAML anchors)
# GitHub Actions does not support YAML anchors natively, so setup steps are duplicated per job.

why: ci.yml's own comment justifies duplicating checkout/Flutter-setup/pub-cache/codegen/secret-decode steps ACROSS ITS OWN JOBS because 'GitHub Actions does not support YAML anchors natively' — true, but the actual GHA-native fix (composite actions / reusable workflows via `uses:`) is never used, and the same six-to-eight-step bootstrap sequence is copy-pasted a further two times whole across build.yml and deploy-play-store.yml (which the stated per-job-isolation rationale doesn't even apply to — they're separate files, not parallel jobs needing independent runners). A future change to how secrets are decoded or how the seed asset is prepared requires finding and editing this sequence in up to 6 places (4 ci.yml jobs + build.yml + deploy-play-store.yml) with no mechanism to catch a missed one.
recommendation: Create `.github/actions/flutter-bootstrap/action.yml` (checkout+setup+cache+codegen+asset-prep+secret-decode) and reference it via `uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-bootstrap` from all three workflow files.
acceptance_criteria: A single composite action exists and build.yml, ci.yml, and deploy-play-store.yml all invoke it instead of repeating the step sequence inline.

corrections: '4 ci.yml jobs' duplicate the full secret-decode/asset-prep sequence -- actual count is 2 (analyze, test); 6 jobs (format-check, analyze, audit, lint, test, arb-parity) share the shorter checkout+setup+cache+install subset instead. The 'up to 6 places' total is therefore off, though real duplication across ci.yml/build.yml/deploy-play-store.yml is confirmed regardless.
